en: Black‑and‑white winter scene showing a dramatic snowplow train clearing deep snow from a railway cutting in mountainous terrain. A huge plume of snow arcs high over the tracks as the rotary snowplow works its way along the line. Telegraph or power poles and overhead wires run beside the track. To the right there is a wooden snow fence on the slope. Printed caption text appears at the bottom left, and a photographer credit at the bottom right.
